22:00 │ EN VIVO AHORA: The Detour With David Chang
David Chang is dead set on visiting the Florida Keys without stopping in Miami, but actor and comedian Eric André blows up the itinerary and leads him on an adventure through Jewish delis, Haitian kitchens, rum bars and alligator farms.

23:00 │ A CONTINUACIÓN: The Whole Story With Anderson Cooper
Donie O'Sullivan examines how, a decade after MAGA remade the right, President Trump's second term has tested the movement's faithful; from die-hard loyalists to the new generation moving further right, he asks if their loyalty can survive.

Canal CNN Internacional
